channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 14
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 14 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 14: Block 14's page said the block is inside PG&E's…
item.description: Block 14's page said the block is inside PG&E's switchyard area. The ordinance enacted in October 2026 redrew that area: its new map puts the PG&E Sub-Area west of Georgia Street and Block 14 outside it, where the 2020 design document had treated the block as part of the area. Only the new 98 ft limit, from November 13, 2026, applies; the 2020 design's 90 ft label never took effect there. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 53-56; BOS File 260724 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 2; Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final (Feb 26, 2020), Figure E.13.4 (printed p. 434) and Figure 1.2.1 (printed p. 12).
item.source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 53-56; BOS File 260724 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 2; Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final (Feb 26, 2020), Figure E.13.4 (printed p. 434) and Figure 1.2.1 (printed p. 12)

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 14: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 14: 98 ft. They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (90 ft) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.

File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 14: The Block 14 page no longer says the block is…
item.description: The Block 14 page no longer says the block is unaddressed in the city's parcel records. DataSF lists an active lot at 1248 Georgia Lane, recorded October 15, 2024, under the whole drawing; it is much larger than the block, and it is not stated whether it is PG&E's switchyard parcel. The older lot the 2018 environmental report named (4175018) was retired the same day. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=4175500 ; https://sfmea.sfplanning.org/2017-011878ENV_DEIR_Volume_1.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 14: Block 14's notes no longer describe it as vacant…
item.description: Block 14's notes no longer describe it as vacant developer land: the Design for Development's Appendix E and site-ownership figure show it inside the PG&E Sub-area, PG&E's roughly 4.8-acre switchyard parcel, which the D4D says may or may not ultimately be redeveloped. The expected completion changed from the 2035 whole-project date to 2030, following the October 2020 Phase 1 approval (Phase 2) and SocketSite's schedule table (vertical development 2029-2030), marked as a soft 2020 forecast that depends on PG&E relocating its switchyard. The use note now cites the D4D's permitted-uses table, the 'first names Block 14' wording was removed, the dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, the land-use figure is tagged as a document rather than a rendering, and publisher names were corrected. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html).
item.source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html)

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 14: Completion expected: Block 14 is in Phase 2 of… (~2030)
item.description: Completion expected: Block 14 is in Phase 2 of the October 2020 re-phased program; SocketSite's block-by-block schedule for that program shows vertical development on Block 14 from 2029 to 2030, contingent on relocation of PG&E's switchyard (~2030). Source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07; SocketSite, 2020-10-09.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 14: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 14; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning (document adopted by the Planning Commission; the D4D names no publisher), 2020-02-26.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning (document adopted by the Planning Commission; the D4D names no publisher), 2020-02-26
